info.description: Per-app site configuration: branding, SEO defaults, promo banner, navigation labels. One row per app (keyed by app_slug), with one row flagged is_default as the fallback.

app_slug.description: App this row configures (e.g. web, pos, cms). Resolution is by app_slug first, then the is_default row. Left empty the row is only reachable by documentId.

is_default.description: Fallback row used when no app_slug matches. Exactly one row carries this — setting it on a row clears it on the others.

site_description.default: Your ultimate destination for premium products at exceptional prices

ga_measurement_id.description: Google Analytics 4 measurement id (G-XXXXXXX). Optional — nothing is injected when empty. The storefront resolves its row by X-Rutba-App: web, so set this on the `web` row (or the is_default row); setting it on another app's row has no effect on the storefront.

meta_pixel_id.description: Meta (Facebook) Pixel id. Optional — nothing is injected when empty.

gtm_container_id.description: Google Tag Manager container id (GTM-XXXXXXX). Optional — nothing is injected when empty.

custom_head_html.description: Raw markup appended to <head> client-side. Injected unescaped — CMS-editor-only, deliberately not exposed in the admin app.

custom_body_end_html.description: Raw markup rendered at the end of <body>. Injected unescaped — CMS-editor-only, deliberately not exposed in the admin app.
